newsitem.title: HONG KONG: AWT places 20 mln shares at HK$0.73 each.
newsitem.headline: AWT places 20 mln shares at HK$0.73 each.

text.p: Air and seafreight forwarder AWT World Transport Holdings Ltd had agreed to privately place 20 million new shares, or 6.66 percent of the expanded share capital, at HK$0.73 per share, the company said in a statement published on Friday.
AWT World said 12 million shares would be placed to independent investor China Insurance Co Ltd, and the remaining eight million shares would be placed to other private investors.
On completion of the placement on October 15, chairman David Leung's stake in the company would be diluted to 24.45 percent from 26.19 percent.
AWT World said the placement would enlarge its capital base and strengthen its financial position, and net proceeds of HK$14 million would be used for general working capital.
The company shares were unchanged at HK$0.76 in early Friday morning trade.
